items.title: Schneider National (SNDR) Expands Eastern U.S. Intermodal Capacity Through New Rail Partnership
items.summary: Schneider National (NYSE:SNDR) has entered a new partnership with Norfolk Southern to expand domestic intermodal capacity in the eastern U.S. The collaboration combines Schneider National's asset based logistics network with Norfolk Southern's rail infrastructure to support more freight volume. Management expects the initiative to support a shift from long haul truckload freight toward rail based intermodal service for shippers. items.title: What Schneider National (SNDR) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
items.summary: Schneider National (NYSE:SNDR) reported higher third-quarter earnings as pricing gains, productivity improvements and cost-control efforts helped offset uneven freight demand and lower equipment counts in parts of its truckload operation. Adjusted income from operations rose 66% from a year earlier

items.title: Rail Rivalry: Schneider’s Bold Move to Norfolk Southern from CSX
items.summary: Schneider is making a monumental shift in its intermodal operations, moving all eastern rail business from CSX to Norfolk Southern. This strategic partnership aims to unlock significant growth, enhance capacity flexibility, and drive more freight off the roads and onto rail.
